hero.title: Lightweight management for businesses that never stop.
hero.copy: Know how much you sold, what is still to be received and which products are running out. Organise your business routine with Mangora.

features.title: When a sale happens, everything else follows.
features.copy: Mangora cuts repeated work because each part of the management updates the next.

sales.label: Sale recorded
sales.title: Sell without losing the pace
sales.copy: Record orders, payments and counter sales in a few steps.
sales.imageLabel: Mangora mascot working on the computer

stock.label: Stock in sync
stock.title: Every sale decreases stock
stock.copy: Inflows, outflows and minimum stock alerts follow your operation.

finance.label: Cash up to date
finance.title: Money without mystery
finance.copy: Revenue, expenses, bills and cash flow together so you decide better.

relationship.label: Organised relationships
relationship.title: Customers and team close by
relationship.copy: Customer, employee and permission history in the right place.

features.systemLine: One system, from the first order to month-end closing.
features.syncTitle: One action updates the whole management

steps.title: Your business organised in three moves.
steps.copy: You start small, configure what you really use and expand when needed.
steps.imageLabel: Mangora mascot pointing at the steps

setup.title: Tell us how your business works
setup.copy: Create the account and register products, services and payment methods.

register.title: Record the day's movement
register.copy: Make sales, take orders and follow inflows and outflows.

decide.title: Decide with the numbers on the table
decide.copy: See cash, stock and performance without building a report by hand.

plans.title: Start at the right size.
plans.imageLabel: Mangora mascot giving a thumbs up
plans.billingNote: No charge is made during the trial. On day 8 your account continues on Free; you only pay if you choose another plan. External integrations may have their own costs.
plans.copy: Try the Start features free for 7 days. Then continue on Free or choose the plan that fits your operation.

card.question: Do I need to enter my card?
card.answer: No. You create your account and start the 7-day Start trial without entering a credit card.

afterTrial.question: What happens after the 7 days?
afterTrial.answer: Your account continues on the Free plan, with that plan's features and limits. To keep using paid features, choose a plan whenever you want.

install.question: Do I need to install any software?
install.answer: Mangora runs in the browser with internet access. You can use it on a computer or phone.

firstSteps.question: Where do I start after signing up?
firstSteps.answer: Register your company and the products or services you sell. Then record a sale and follow the data in the system.

doubt.question: Can I ask a question before signing up?
doubt.answer: Yes. Use the Talk to Mangora button below to get in touch on WhatsApp.

cta.eyebrow: The next sale can be simpler
cta.imageLabel: Mangora mascot inviting you to start
cta.title: Start with the next sale.
cta.copy: You get 7 days to sell, organise and feel the difference in the routine. You start without a card and decide later.

segments.title: The routine changes. Mangora adapts.
segments.copy: Choose the modules that make sense for your operation, without carrying features you never use.

footer.availability: Management available whenever your business needs it.

meta.title: Mangora — online business management
meta.description: Lightweight management for stores, restaurants, salons and service providers: sales, stock, finance and customers in one place.

benefits.title: Less typing. More business insight.
benefits.copy: The sale decreases stock, moves the cash and appears on your dashboard. That is how the routine gains time.
